recs.stt: What if writing tests was a joyful experience?
recs.x:

(see Hilel Wayne's excellent video on this topic [link] )

cites.x: I found this talk (by the same person being interviewed) to be concise and convincing on how to do better than typical practice, without going to full formal methods.
